An important WireGuard compatibility issue

This is the biggest thing I would check before buying.

WireGuard running in Docker is not automatically supported just because a NAS supports Docker. Some WireGuard containers depend on the NAS's Linux kernel having the WireGuard kernel module.

QNAP: QVPN has an officially supported WireGuard server on compatible x86 models running QTS 5.0 and QVPN 3.0. 
QNAP (US)
+1

UGREEN: DXP2800 officially supports Docker, but you should verify WireGuard kernel-module availability on your specific UGOS firmware before relying on a container-based VPN. 
UGOS, Docker & VM Support
+1

ASUSTOR: AdGuard Home is available through its App Central for supported models. 
ASUSTOR NAS

My suggested setup:

Run AdGuard Home as your primary DNS server.

Configure your router's DHCP to distribute the NAS's AdGuard IP as DNS.

Run WireGuard as a VPN server.

Configure your phone and laptop to use WireGuard when away from home.

Configure WireGuard clients to use AdGuard as their DNS server.

Only expose the WireGuard UDP port to the internet, not the NAS administration interface or DNS port.
